subject.title: [Bug]: ensureGlobalUndiciEnvProxyDispatcher() breaks COS chunked upload via qqbot plugin

question: Should OpenClaw solve this qqbot/COS regression by accepting a generic global dispatcher NO_PROXY bypass layer, or require a narrower plugin/COS transport fix?
rationale: The bug is credible, but the leading candidate changes process-wide egress behavior and managed-proxy semantics, which needs maintainer security-boundary intent rather than automated cleanup.

options.title: Accept generic core fix after review
options.body: Land a repaired generic dispatcher solution that preserves documented defaults and makes NO_PROXY behavior explicit across global fetch paths.

options.title: Narrow to qqbot transport
options.body: Reject broader process-wide bypass changes and require the qqbot media transport to use an explicit direct dispatcher for COS uploads.

options.title: Wait for live repro first
options.body: Hold both issue closure and core proxy policy changes until a maintainer or contributor reproduces the real COS upload failure end to end.

recommendation.title: Accept generic core fix after review
recommendation.body: Land a repaired generic dispatcher solution that preserves documented defaults and makes NO_PROXY behavior explicit across global fetch paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent trusted env-proxy and matchesNoProxy work makes this the best available routing owner for the proxy/security-boundary choice.
